# Provo SEO Pros

> SEO company in Provo, Utah, serving local businesses across the United States and Canada since 2001. Founder-led by Rich Soto.

## Services
- [Growth Engine System](https://provoseopros.com/service/growth-engine/): one coordinated marketing system covering SEO, AI search, website, Google Business Profile, reviews, campaigns and tracking. From $2,500 one-time.
- [Guided Implementation](https://provoseopros.com/local-authority-guided-implementation/): a focused buildout of local SEO, Google Business Profile, service pages, website conversion and trust assets, then ongoing approved work. From $7,500 + $2,500/mo.
- [Local Visibility Starter](https://provoseopros.com/pricing/): ongoing Google Business Profile, local SEO essentials, light technical cleanup and monthly reporting. From $900/mo + $500 setup.
- [SEO & AI Search Optimization](https://provoseopros.com/service/seo-ai-search-optimization/): clearer service pages, stronger local relevance and a technically sound site. From $2,500 one-time.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://provoseopros.com/service/google-business-profile-management/): a complete, accurate, trusted profile. From $900/mo + $500 setup.
- [Website Design & Conversion Optimization](https://provoseopros.com/service/website-design-conversion-optimization/): a clear, mobile-ready website built to turn visitors into calls and form submissions. From $3,500.
- [CRM Automation & Lead Follow-Up](https://provoseopros.com/service/crm-automation/): automated lead capture, instant text and email replies, follow-up sequences. From $1,500 setup + $300/mo.
- [PPC Advertising Management](https://provoseopros.com/service/ppc-advertising-management/): Google Ads campaigns around your highest-value services. From $750/mo + ad spend.
- [Social Media Management](https://provoseopros.com/service/social-media-management/): consistent, on-brand posts. From $750/mo.

## Areas served
United States and Canada, remotely.

## Facts
- Founded: 2001, by Rich Soto
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Mountain Time
- First step: a free 30-minute Growth Audit call
- Terms: ongoing plans have a 6-month minimum, then month to month with 30 days' notice. Scope and terms confirmed in writing before work begins.
- No ranking, traffic or lead timeline guarantees.
